newsitem.title: USA: Triangle raises $3.3 mln in over-allotments.
newsitem.headline: Triangle raises $3.3 mln in over-allotments.

text.p: Triangle Pharmaceuticals Inc said Wednesday it raised an additional $3,326,520 from the underwriters of its recent initial public offering.
Dillon Read & Co Inc and Bear Stearns & Co Inc, managing underwriters for the deal, exercised their over-allotment option by purchasing 332,652 shares of common stock at $10 per share, Triangle said.
Total gross proceeds raised by Triangle Pharmaceuticals from the offering, including the exercise of the over- allotment option, comes to $45,326,520, the company said in a release.
